item.title: Sotto 0.3.8
item.description:
• Settings › Appearance has a new choice: Auto, Light or Dark. Auto follows macOS, as before; Light or Dark keeps every Sotto window, menu and alert in that look. The orb and live-words bubble keep following macOS, since they sit over other apps.
  • When your words land by typing into a text field, a thin line sweeps under what was just added and drains into the cursor, so you can see where it went. If an app can't say where its lines are, a short glint plays at the cursor instead. In iTerm2 the line shows only when Sotto can confirm the text just before the cursor is what it typed; other terminals and pasted text get nothing. It's off with Reduce Motion, in the Classic theme, and when Show live words is off.
  • Yesterday: stepping to another day while History is being updated no longer jumps back to the day you left, and two quick steps both count. A day you stepped away from before it loaded still plays its opening the first time you see it.
